verdict.rationale: Codex CLI can explore unfamiliar code, edit files, run local dev tools, run a dedicated review against uncommitted changes/commits/base branches to surface prioritized findings, accept error screenshots for context, invoke live web search for external behavior, and create git checkpoints before/after tasks so changes can be reverted and verified — directly supporting reproduce/root-cause/verify workflows (codex-docs-9, codex-docs-10, codex-docs-12, codex-docs-14, codex-docs-40). Community sentiment is mixed on overall model quality/speed but does not concretely contradict this specific capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on case study specifically demonstrating end-to-end bug reproduction→root-cause→fix-verification, and no dispute-level evidence either way.
